name: dca-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugins for Domain-Centric Architecture (DCA) and general software craftsmanship — composable skills and reviewer agents for daily practice.

plugins.name: dca-core
plugins.description: DCA-specific skills and agents for Java/Spring and .NET/C#: bootstrap that adds the published dca-building-blocks/dca-archunit or DomainCentric.BuildingBlocks/ArchRules packages and generates one architecture test, framework-free domain discipline, ubiquitous language glossaries, strategic context maps, scaffolding and semantic review, plus DDD and Hexagonal reviewer agents. Pairs well with software-craftsmanship.

plugins.name: software-craftsmanship
plugins.description: Project-agnostic craftsmanship skills and agents: Test-Driven Development workflow, Clean Code principles while writing, Architecture Decision Records, and a Clean-Code reviewer. Usable on any Java or .NET project — no DCA assumptions.

plugins.name: dca-factory
plugins.description: Delivery pipeline for DCA projects: a markdown backlog contract (epics with intent, goal, outcome-event metric and domain contact), the stage skills plan/test/build/judge with file hand-overs, a dependency-free story gate script that checks epic completeness and one red-then-green end-user test per acceptance criterion, and one orchestrator skill. Carries no architecture method and no project knowledge — those stay in dca-core and in the project's stack profile.
